heroHeadline: Drone Crosses Directly Into Transnistrian Sector Near Cuciurgan — 13th Airspace Breach Since Aug 9
heroSubtitle: An unidentified aerial object crossed into Moldovan airspace at 15:50 local time on August 30 near Dnestrovsk, in the Transnistrian-administered sector close to the Cuciurgan (MGRES) power plant, before returning toward Ukraine's Lymanske nine minutes later. It was the eighth confirmed breach event and thirteenth individual crossing since August 9, and the first to occur directly over Russian-administered Transnistria rather than the Ștefan Vodă or Gagauzia frontier districts, where Chisinau normally has no ground access to investigate wreckage. The crossing came three days after a five-drone overnight wave swept the Ștefan Vodă frontier ahead of Moldova's 35th Independence Day, during which President Maia Sandu pledged new air-defense investment and closer Moldova-Ukraine-Romania threat-sharing.
